correctness.rationale: After affine normalization of the inner ellipsoid to the unit ball, an outer ellipsoid has cap fraction C_d((t-c·u)/s). Nesting gives c·u+s>=1. Choosing c·u>=0 and using 0<=t<=1 yields c·u+ts-t=t(c·u+s-1)+(1-t)c·u>=0, hence (t-c·u)/s<=t. Monotonicity of the unit-ball cap function then gives beta>=alpha for every alpha with the same normal. Affine transport completes the theorem.
risks: No nonstandard external lemma is needed; the only boundary point alpha=1/2 is handled by t=0.

This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical recomputation, while remaining appropriately narrower than the open arbitrary-convex-body problem.
